<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkLiveAustria" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanSplit" name="Plan the required steps"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Accommodation" name="Organize accommodation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Negotiate accommodation.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BankAccount" name="Organize bank account">
      <bpmn:documentation>Negotiate a bank account.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCard" name="Manage visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application">
      <bpmn:documentation>Repeat this application workflow when another visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application or renewal is due. The interval is not specified and is represented as x months.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application or renewal is due at the applicable interval (x months).</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyOffice" name="Identify the competent representation office">
        <bpmn:documentation>For Schengen visas, the country of the main travel destination is responsible. If equal time is spent in several countries, determine the main destination from the length and purpose of the stay; if it cannot be determined, the country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible. For category A and C applications, territorial competence is the representation office for the applicant's legal place of residence; exceptional competence may be claimed for a legally resident third-country national not registered in that district if the applicant justifies applying there. Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence or centre of interest, which may be verified by registration forms, residence permits or visas. Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specific exceptional cases, certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, state police headquarters may issue them.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactOffice" name="Contact the representation office in advance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Ask for further information about local requirements and any additional documents that may be requested. Representation office addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements are available from the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplicationForm" name="Complete the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelDocument" name="Check the travel document">
        <bpmn:documentation>Check that it is valid in Austria, was issued within the last ten years, has at least two empty pages, and remains valid for at least three months beyond the visa duration.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PassportPhoto" name="Prepare the passport photo">
        <bpmn:documentation>Prepare a portrait-format photo, 35 x 45 mm, meeting the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Insurance" name="Arrange travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive insurance for the planned stay, valid throughout the Schengen area, with cover of 30,000 Euro.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Means" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherEvidence" name="Gather other requested evidence">
        <bpmn:documentation>Evidence may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Requirements may vary by location.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" name="Are additional documents requested?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs" name="Provide additional documents"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge" name="Continue preparation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
        <bpmn:documentation>Check for a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" name="Is a refusal ground present?"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RefusalGround" name="Refusal ground identified"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit the application to the competent office">
        <bpmn:documentation>Submit the completed application and supporting evidence to the competent issuing office for assessment.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Application submitted"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_01" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_IdentifyOffice"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyOffice" targetRef="Task_ContactOffice"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_03" sourceRef="Task_ContactOffice" targetRef="Task_ApplicationForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_04" sourceRef="Task_ApplicationForm" targetRef="Task_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_05" sourceRef="Task_TravelDocument" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_06" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Task_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_07" sourceRef="Task_Insurance" targetRef="Task_Means"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_08" sourceRef="Task_Means" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_09" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_10" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_11" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_12" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_13" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_14" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_15" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="End_RefusalGround"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_16" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_17" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanJoin" name="Planning steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLiveAustria" name="Planning steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_01" sourceRef="Start_WorkLiveAustria" targetRef="Gateway_PlanSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_02" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_03" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_05" sourceRef="Task_Accommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_06" sourceRef="Task_BankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_07" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCard" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanJoin" targetRef="End_WorkLiveAustria"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:documentation>The visa requirements below are based on the requirements described. The description does not specify separate Rot-Weiss-Rot Card requirements. The cycle recurs every x months.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further visa / Rot-Weiss-Rot Card cycle is due every x months.</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin visa cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineVisaType" name="Determine visa type"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IsTypeD" name="Is this a type D visa?"/>

        <bpmn:documentation>Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation. Territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence or centre of interest, verifiable, for example, by registration forms, residence permits or visas.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineSchengenDestination" name="Determine the main travel destination">
        <bpmn:documentation>For equal time in several countries, determine the main destination on the basis of the length and purpose of the stay.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationKnown" name="Can the main destination be determined?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDestinationCountry" name="Select destination country representation">
        <bpmn:documentation>Schengen visas are issued by the representation office of the country where the main travel destination is located.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry" name="Select first-entry country representation">
        <bpmn:documentation>If a main travel destination cannot be determined, the member country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Destination responsibility determined"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineTerritorialCompetence" name="Determine territorial competence">
        <bpmn:documentation>For category A and C applications, territorial competence falls to the representation office in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. A representation office may claim exceptional competence for a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying there. Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad; in specific exceptional cases they may be issued by certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, state police headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfficeMerge" name="Competent office determined"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactOffice" name="Contact the representation office in advance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Ask for information about local requirements and any additional documents that may be requested. Addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special requirements for representation offices are available from the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" name="Prepare application materials"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplicationForm" name="Complete the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelDocument" name="Check the travel document">
        <bpmn:documentation>It must be valid in Austria, issued within the last ten years, have at least two empty pages, and remain valid for at least three months beyond the duration of the visa.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PassportPhoto" name="Prepare the passport photo">
        <bpmn:documentation>Prepare a portrait-format photo, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelInsurance" name="Arrange travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive cover of 30,000 Euro for the planned duration of the stay, valid throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_MeansOfSubsistence" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherEvidence" name="Gather other relevant evidence">
        <bpmn:documentation>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Evidence requirements may vary by location.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin" name="Required materials prepared"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" name="Provide additional documents"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" name="Continue application preparation"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
        <bpmn:documentation>Check for a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" name="Is another ground for refusal present?"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RefusalGround" name="Ground for refusal identified"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit the application to the competent office"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Application submitted"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_01" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_DetermineVisaType"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_02" sourceRef="Task_DetermineVisaType" targetRef="Gateway_IsTypeD"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_03" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_IsTypeD" targetRef="Task_DetermineTypeDOffice">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa is type D.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_04" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_IsTypeD" targetRef="Task_DetermineSchengenDestination">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The visa is not type D.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_05" sourceRef="Task_DetermineSchengenDestination" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationKnown"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_06" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationKnown" targetRef="Task_SelectDestinationCountry">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A main travel destination can be determined.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_07" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationKnown" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A main travel destination cannot be determined.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_08" sourceRef="Task_SelectDestinationCountry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_09" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstEntryCountry" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_10" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Task_DetermineTerritorialCompetence"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_15" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplicationForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_17" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_18" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_TravelInsurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_19" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_MeansOfSubsistence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_20" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_21" sourceRef="Task_ApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_22" sourceRef="Task_TravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_23" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_24" sourceRef="Task_TravelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_25" sourceRef="Task_MeansOfSubsistence" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_26" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_27" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_28" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The relevant authority requests additional documents.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_29" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The relevant authority does not request additional documents.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_30" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_31" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_32" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds"/>

      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_34" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No other ground for refusal is present.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_35" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanJoin" name="Planning steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLiveAustria" name="Planning steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_01" sourceRef="Start_WorkLiveAustria" targetRef="Gateway_PlanSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_02" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_03" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_05" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_06" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_07" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCard" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanJoin" targetRef="End_WorkLiveAustria"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" name="Is a ground for refusal present?"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RefusalGround" name="Refusal ground identified"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit the application to the competent authority"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Application submitted"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_01" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_DetermineAuthority"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_02" sourceRef="Task_DetermineAuthority" targetRef="Task_ContactOffice"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_03" sourceRef="Task_ContactOffice" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplicationForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_05" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_Means"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_09" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_10" sourceRef="Task_ApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_11" sourceRef="Task_TravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_12" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_13" sourceRef="Task_Insurance" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_14" sourceRef="Task_Means" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_15" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_17" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalDocumentsRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_18" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not additionalDocumentsRequested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_19" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_20" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_21" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_22" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="End_RefusalGround">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refusalGroundPresent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_23" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not refusalGroundPresent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_24" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanJoin" name="Planning steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLiveAustria" name="Planning steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_01" sourceRef="Start_WorkLiveAustria" targetRef="Gateway_PlanSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_02" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_03" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_05" sourceRef="Task_Accommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_06" sourceRef="Task_BankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_07" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCard" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanJoin" targetRef="End_WorkLiveAustria"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_VisaAuthority" name="Competent visa issuing authority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ContactAuthority" name="Contact for information" sourceRef="Task_ContactOffice" targetRef="Participant_VisaAuthority"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitApplication" name="Visa application and supporting evidence" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_VisaAuthority"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WorkLiveAustria" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanSplit" name="Plan the required steps"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Accommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BankAccount" name="Negotiate a bank account"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_VisaCard" name="Manage visa and Rot-Weiss-Rot Card">
      <bpmn:documentation>Repeat the application workflow when the next visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card step is due. The interval is described as x months but is not specified further. The general visa requirements below are modeled as stated.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A further visa or Rot-Weiss-Rot Card application or renewal is due after x months.</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_VisaCycle" name="Begin visa application cycle"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyOffice" name="Identify the competent issuing office">
        <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad. In specific exceptional cases they may be issued by certain border control posts or, where visa extension is permitted, by state police headquarters. For a Schengen visa, the responsible country is the country of the main travel destination. If equal time is spent in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay; if no main destination can be determined, the country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible. Territorial competence for category A and C applications is the representation office for the applicant's legal place of residence. A representation office may claim exceptional competence for a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying there. Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation. For Type D visas, territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence or centre of interest, verifiable, for example, by registration forms, a residence permit or a visa.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ContactOffice" name="Contact the representation office in advance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Ask about further information and additional documents that may be requested. Addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours and special visa requirements for representation offices are available on the website of the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" name="Prepare application materials"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplicationForm" name="Complete the visa application form"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TravelDocument" name="Prepare a valid travel document">
        <bpmn:documentation>The document must be valid in Austria, issued within the last ten years, have at least two empty pages, and remain valid for at least three months beyond the duration of the visa.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_PassportPhoto" name="Prepare a passport photo">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide a portrait-format photo, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Insurance" name="Arrange travel health insurance">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive cover for the planned duration of the stay, valid throughout the Schengen area, with cover of 30,000 Euro.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_Means" name="Prepare proof of sufficient means">
        <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherEvidence" name="Prepare other locally required evidence">
        <bpmn:documentation>Evidence requested by the relevant authorities may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. Evidence may vary by location.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin" name="Application materials prepared"/>

      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" name="Are additional documents requested?" default="Flow_Visa_NoAdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs" name="Provide additional documents"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge" name="Continue application preparation"/>

      <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
        <bpmn:documentation>Check for a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" name="Is another ground for refusal present?" default="Flow_Visa_NoRefusalGround"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RefusalGround" name="Ground for refusal identified"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit the application to the competent office"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Application submitted"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_01" sourceRef="Start_VisaCycle" targetRef="Task_IdentifyOffice"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyOffice" targetRef="Task_ContactOffice"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_03" sourceRef="Task_ContactOffice" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplicationForm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_05" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_TravelDocument"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_Insurance"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_Means"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_09" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsSplit" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_10" sourceRef="Task_ApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_11" sourceRef="Task_TravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_12" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_13" sourceRef="Task_Insurance" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_14" sourceRef="Task_Means" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_15" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_16" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepareDocumentsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_17" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Additional documents are requested.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_NoAdditionalDocs" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_19" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalDocs" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_20" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocsMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_21" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_22" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="End_RefusalGround">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A residence prohibition or a Schengen-country alert is present.</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_NoRefusalGround" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefusalGrounds" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Visa_24" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="End_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanJoin" name="Planning steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_WorkLiveAustria" name="Planning steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_01" sourceRef="Start_WorkLiveAustria" targetRef="Gateway_PlanSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_02" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_03" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="Task_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_04" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_VisaCard"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_05" sourceRef="Task_Accommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_06" sourceRef="Task_BankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_07" sourceRef="SubProcess_VisaCard" targetRef="Gateway_PlanJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Main_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanJoin" targetRef="End_WorkLiveAustria"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
